economy.basis: economy off = the logo and the office geocoding of the pipeline back on: ~0.001 $ each per position with the Analista on Haiku (T323, 18/11/2026); ~0.01 $ each on Sonnet

logo.enabled.basis: the logo step of the Analista's pipeline, ~0.001 $ a call on Haiku, ~0.01 $ on Sonnet (T323, share of the turn: logo_fetch itself is a script, no model)

geocode_pipeline.enabled.basis: geocode-check and the office geocoding of the Analista's pipeline, ~0.001 $ a call on Haiku, ~0.01 $ on Sonnet (T323)

geocode_missing.enabled.basis: the same step as geocode_pipeline, done on the backlog by the care queue: not measured on its own, the T323 figure of the step

geocode_missing.non_remote_only.basis: off = the remote positions too go through the geocoding step, ~0.001 $ a call on Haiku (T323)

recheck_weekly.enabled.basis: not measured: no recheck ran in the T323 rounds

web_search.analista.enabled.basis: T323 bis (18/11/2026), Analista on Haiku: 0.27 $ per position with the search (39 searches on 3 positions, results beyond 100k tokens of context, billed 5x) against 0.008 $ without

web_search.scout.enabled.basis: a search on Haiku costs ~0.02 $ (0.01 $ fee + ~0.009 $ of tokens, T323 bis), at most 3 a turn; the Scouts of the round searched 0 times, so no figure per position

web_search.mentor.enabled.basis: a search on Haiku costs ~0.02 $ (T323 bis), at most 5 a turn; the Mentor does not work per position
